newsitem.title: USA: Hvide says stock downgrade overdone.
newsitem.headline: Hvide says stock downgrade overdone.

text.p: Hvide Marine, whose stock fell 22.62 percent on Monday, said the pessimistic outlook presented in a conference call by Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette was overdone.
"Arvind Sanger has called the top on the whole industry," said a spokesman for the company.
Hvide shares closed off 4-3/4 at 16-1/4, having been as low as 14-7/8.
Sanger lowered earnings multiples for the sector and cited the firm order for 10 new offshore support vessels plus seven provisional orders by Edison Chouest, a privately-held company.
"We have other assets such as chemical carriers and only half our earnings come from the offshore," said the Hvide spokesman.
